description: This file defines a custom SQLite driver ('sqlitepo') and a recordset class for the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP, including modifications to strip table names from result fields.

classes.name: ADODB_sqlitepo
classes.description: A custom SQLite driver class extending the base ADODB_sqlite to modify behavior for 'sqlitepo' type.

classes.name: ADORecordset_sqlitepo
classes.description: A recordset class extending ADORecordset_sqlite, overriding the _fetch method to strip table names from field names in query results.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Fetches a row from the database, stripping table prefixes from column names in the result set.
